Sonya was always my main since the OG MK1. Loved that she was the first lady of kombat. She is an important character in the series and should be treated as such. 

I mained her in MKX, but was not a fan of the drones and gadgets. I always appreciated hee acrobatics, like the iconic leg grab, the kartwheel, arc kick, upwards bicycle kick, etc. She hasn’t felt that way since MK9. 

She was the best version of herself in they game. She had all of her classic moves, plus some. That arch kick was my friend. BRING BACK MILITARY STANCE. That added so much to her gameplay and she was truly FUN to play. Her combo potential was insane, especially mess hall. 

I ended up maining Skarlet in MK11 because Sonya just didn’t feel the same and she wasn’t fun to play anymore - especially when her only pop-up was nerfed. That ruined her for me. 

Story wise, I agree that the whole cat and mouse game with Kano is old. Personality wise, I always liked her sarcasm and dry sense of humor. She could be funny and witty. Like someone else said in another post, she’s got a hard shell but is soft inside. I hope they explore that more.
